items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: Or down at Charlie Armstead's. Club Desire, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Because Professor Longhair played the Pepper Potty. He played the Greystone. We went out to Back Vashery, Front Vashery. We went to Baton Rouge. You know, all these little places along the river had little nightclubs. And Professor Longhair was popular about playing these places. And we went to these places. And we played on weekends. Mostly weekends, it was. And his main spot was, like I said, the hi-hat. He played the hi-hat all the time. Or down at Charlie Armstead's. Club Desire, yeah. And we used…
